title: $:/plugins/xyvir/lithic-richlinks
description: Displays external links as rich objects: YouTube, GitHub, Wikipedia, SoundCloud, jsFiddle, Disqus, tweets, PDFs, text files, images, audio, video, generic iframes. Nativized into a proper plugin from the RichLinks revisited demosite.
name: Lithic Richlinks
author: Xyvir
readme:
!Lithic Richlinks

Displays external links as rich objects. Type:

```
<<richlink "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID">>
```

and the link is replaced by an embedded player, viewer or styled link depending on what it points to. One command, many shapes — the URL itself picks the template:

* Domain templates (e.g. `d@youtube`, `d@github`, `d@wikipedia`, `d@soundcloud`, `d@jsfiddle`, `d@disq.us`, `d@twitter`, `docs@tiddlywiki`)
* File templates (e.g. `f@txt`, `fimg@jpg@jpeg@png@gif@webp@svg`, `faudio@mp3@ogg@wav@flac`, `fvideo@mp4@avi@webm@ogv`)
* Generic [[$:/plugins/richlink/iframe]] template as a fallback

!Extra parameters

Some templates accept extra parameters after the URL, e.g. an image caption or an iframe height:

```
<<richlink "https://example.com/photo.jpg" "my caption">>
<<richlink iframe "https://example.com/page" "description" "site" "600px">>
```

Within a template the URL is available as `<<link>>` and the extra parameters as `<<1>>`, `<<2>>`, `<<3>>` and `<<4>>`.

!In the editor

Type `/richlinks` in the editor to insert `<<richlink "">>` with the caret placed inside the quotes — just paste a URL.

!Test links

Verified embed-friendly URLs for each template:

```
<<richlink "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ">>                          <!-- d@youtube     -->
<<richlink "https://github.com/Jermolene/TiddlyWiki5">>                            <!-- d@github      -->
<<richlink "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TiddlyWiki">>                            <!-- d@wikipedia   -->
<<richlink "https://example.com/">>                                               <!-- iframe fallback -->
<<richlink iframe "https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=-0.004,51.476,0.006,51.482&layer=mapnik" "OpenStreetMap" "openstreetmap.org" "450px">>  <!-- forced iframe -->
```

Iframe-embeddable targets (no `X-Frame-Options` / CSP `frame-ancestors` block): `example.com`, the OpenStreetMap / YouTube / Vimeo / Bing Maps embed endpoints, and Wikipedia pages.

!Notes

* The tweet template renders tweets via the official Twitter plugin when installed, and falls back to a plain link otherwise.
* Text files are fetched and rendered inline with palette colours when the host allows CORS (e.g. `raw.githubusercontent.com`); otherwise they fall back to an unstyled iframe.
* SoundCloud only embeds track/set URLs (e.g. `https://soundcloud.com/zedd/clarity-1`), not the homepage.
* Based on the [[RichLinks revisited demosite|https://richlinkrevistedii.tiddlyhost.com/]] by Mat von TWaddle and JanJo.

readme:
The jspython engine allows you to run python in tiddlywiki.

Provides an `<$action-jspython>` widget for executing Python code in the browser using JSpython.

Features a playground in the sidebar for quickly testing scripts.
